Easy running builds the aerobic base: more capillaries, more mitochondria and stronger tendons, with little fatigue. Many runners go too fast on easy days, which makes them too tired for the hard sessions. Keeping heart rate below roughly seventy five percent of maximum, or using the talk test, keeps easy runs easy. Over months the pace at the same heart rate gets faster, which is the clearest sign the base is growing. Easy mileage is the bulk of any [[Marathon training plan]].
